# Record 20260815-072956-34e5253

- **Record ID**: 20260815-072956-34e5253
- **Claim**: spec/tmds-tx.md#dr-0002 -- single-ended swing 400-600 mV and common mode 2.8-3.3 V into 50 ohm/leg with a ~10 mA tail, plus the Vgs/Vgd/Vds margin against the 3.3 V core devices' rated limit that DR-0002 explicitly deferred to the driver design work -- and spec/tmds-tx.md #2's remaining-jitter row, this stage's <= 0.15 UI peak-to-peak allocation, at both #1 operating points (742.5 Mbps/lane target, 270 Mbps/lane fallback). POST-LAYOUT RE-RUN of the schematic-level record 20260810-041436-a2c358b: identical testbench deck, manifest, measurements and checks, driven instead by the layout-extracted netlist of layout/gds/cml_driver_core.gds (klt extract --deck gf180mcu -> layout/gds/cml_driver_core.spice, LVS-matched against layout/lvs/cml_driver_core.ref.spice in issue #22), bound to the PDK models by layout/scripts/gen_cml_driver_core_dut.py -> layout/sim/cml_driver_core_dut.spice. EXTRACTION COVERAGE, stated explicitly per measurements/characterization.md's coverage-honesty requirement. WHAT THIS MODELS: the drawn device geometry of the real cell (338 extracted per-finger nfets, each carrying its own drawn W/L and its own drawn source/drain junction area and perimeter AS/AD/PS/PD, with shared diffusions split between neighbouring fingers) and the drawn intra-cell connectivity, DRC-clean and LVS-matched against the sized schematic. WHAT THIS DOES NOT MODEL: (1) no interconnect parasitic R/C -- the source extraction is schematic-equivalent (devices + connectivity), klt extract --parasitics was NOT used, so intra-cell metal resistance and coupling/ground capacitance are absent; (2) no source/drain diffusion sheet resistance -- the extraction carries no NRD/NRS, so nfet_03v3's 0 defaults apply, unlike the schematic DUT which states them; (3) body/bulk -- gf180mcu has no distinct substrate-tap layer, so klt ties every device body to one deck-synthesized global net 'vsubs' regardless of drawn tap geometry (klt lvs reports this as a device.body_unverified warning); the DUT wrapper ties vsubs to VSS, the sized schematic's own intended tie for this NMOS-only cell in the common p-substrate, so substrate resistance between taps is not modelled; (4) cell scope -- the core driver cell only: no pad, no ESD clamp, no package and no board (pad capacitance is still swept in-deck at 0/1/2 pF exactly as in the schematic record, and the 50 ohm/leg termination is still the testbench's ideal load); (5) PDK variant -- the layout and its extraction were produced against gf180mcuC while this simulation uses the gf180mcuD models sim/pdk.json pins, the same open_pdks revision, an open discrepancy owned by issue #9. This is therefore device-level post-layout evidence, not parasitic-RC post-layout evidence, and it does not supersede the schematic record's standing as the swing/common-mode claim -- it corroborates it against the drawn geometry. Corner-by-corner deltas against 20260810-041436-a2c358b are computed by sim/compare_records.py and analysed in measurements/characterization.md.
